name: Below the Working World
description:
Mara thinks the miners were wiser than the kings: they hid their treasure where somebody might need it.

Search abandoned mineshaft or ordinary dungeon chests. Earn End Remastered's lost eye advancement by obtaining the eye. This record keeps working after you use the eye. Eyes are never consumed by this quest. Loot can be random; choose other routes for the portal if a source proves elusive.
